Switch IDs and version numbers come from the filename and TitleDB. They classify a likely base game, update or DLC; they do not verify the package bytes. When enabled, only TitleDB identified updates and DLC are routed to the folders below.

Switch title IDs and versions are read from filenames and TitleDB. They help group base games, updates and DLC, but do not verify the package bytes. Exact DAT checksums or a manual confirmation are required before ROMarr offers a rename.
